title: Stability for the inverse source problem of the stochastic fractional Helmholtz equation
summary: This paper is concerned with the inverse source problem for the stochastic fractional Helmholtz equation driven by white noise. For every fractional order $0<α<1$, we prove the existence and uniqueness of the outgoing distributional solution to the direct problem with resolvent estimates at high frequencies, and establish its stochastic representation. For the inverse problem, we demonstrate that the variance of the source can be uniquely determined by the correlated random exterior data at a single frequency.
